fullDescription: Light-mode 'Tabular' product page built around one responsive data table that is a real desktop table on wide screens and collapses each row into a labeled stacked card below 920px, in pure CSS with no JavaScript: teal accent on near-white, status pills, tabular-nums columns, a sticky blurred nav, a dark prompt-library strip, and a teal CTA band.
prompt:
## Resumo
A light-mode 'Tabular' product landing page whose centerpiece is one responsive data table that renders as a real desktop table on wide screens and collapses each row into a labeled stacked card the moment the viewport gets narrow. Flow: a blurred sticky nav, a grid-dot hero with a big black headline, a live-preview table section, a full-bleed dark prompt-library strip, a 3-up features grid, a full-bleed teal CTA band, and a footer. The library value is the responsive table-to-cards mechanic done with zero JS: thead hides, tr becomes a bordered card, each td flexes label-vs-value via content: attr(data-label).

## Estilo Visual
Design system: light mode. Page background canvas #f8fafc; primary ink text #0f172a (ink-900), with body text in #1e293b (ink-800) and muted #475569 (ink-600) / #64748b (ink-500). Single accent is a teal ramp: 50 #f0fdfa, 100 #ccfbf1, 200 #99f6e4, 300 #5eead4, 400 #2dd4bf, 500 #14b8a6, 600 #0d9488, 700 #0f766e (PRIMARY brand/buttons/links), 800 #115e59 (hover), 900 #134e4a. Neutral 'ink' slate ramp: 50 #f8fafc, 100 #f1f5f9, 200 #e2e8f0, 300 #cbd5e1, 400 #94a3b8, 500 #64748b, 600 #475569, 700 #334155, 800 #1e293b, 900 #0f172a. Borders are ink-200 #e2e8f0 with hairlines in #f1f5f9. Semantic status pills: teal (On track) bg #f0fdfa / text #0f766e / dot #14b8a6, amber (At risk) bg amber-50 / text amber-700 / dot amber-500, rose (Overdue) bg rose-50 / text rose-700 / dot rose-500. Typeface: Inter, weights 400/500/600/700/800/900, antialiased, font-feature-settings 'cv02' 'cv03' 'cv04' 'cv11'; numeric table columns use font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums (.num, right-aligned). Headings are black/extrabold with tight tracking (tracking-tight). Shadows: card panel = 0 10px 30px -18px rgba(15,118,110,0.30) + 0 2px 6px rgba(15,23,42,0.04); mobile card = 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,0.04) + 0 8px 20px -16px rgba(15,118,110,0.30); buttons carry a soft shadow-sm. Rounding: table panel rounded-18px, hero/CTA buttons rounded-xl, feature/library cards rounded-2xl, status pills rounded-full (999px). Icons via Iconify Lucide set (table-2, arrow-right, sparkles, smartphone, check-circle-2, info, layout-list, credit-card, users, accessibility, code-2) at 13-22px. A faint teal dotted/line grid background sits behind the hero (two linear-gradients at rgba(15,118,110,0.05), 28px tiles).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky nav
Sticky top-0 z-50 header on canvas at 80% opacity with backdrop-blur-md and an ink-200/70 bottom border, h-16 (64px) inside a max-w-6xl row. Left: a brand lockup = an 8x8 rounded-lg teal-700 (#0f766e) tile holding a white Lucide 'table-2' icon, then the wordmark 'Tabular' in extrabold ink-900 tracking-tight ~18px. Center (hidden on mobile, md:flex): text nav links Preview / Library / Features / Pricing in 14px medium ink-600 with teal-700 hover. Right: a 'Sign in' ghost text link (hidden on small) and a teal-700 'Start free' primary button (white, semibold, px-4 py-2 rounded-lg shadow-sm, trailing arrow-right icon) that darkens to teal-800 on hover.

### Hero
Full-bleed section on the faint teal grid background (grid-bg) with a bottom ink-200/70 border and a thin teal-300 gradient hairline across the very top edge. Centered content in the container (py-20 to py-24): a small rounded-full pill badge (teal-200 border, teal-50 fill, teal-700 text) reading 'Prompt-to-table, designed for real screens' with a leading sparkles icon; then a huge black (font-black) headline ~36px scaling to 60px, leading-[1.05], tracking-tight: 'Tables that stay readable from desktop to pocket.' with 'desktop' and 'pocket' in teal-700; a 16-18px ink-600 subhead (max-w-xl); two centered CTAs: primary teal-700 'See it adapt' (smartphone icon) + white outlined 'Browse the library' (ink-300 border, teal hover); and a centered trust row of three 14px ink-500 items each with a teal-600 check-circle-2 icon: Semantic HTML / WCAG-aware / Zero JS to render.

### Live preview header
Section heading row above the table (flex, column on mobile, row + items-end on sm): left = a 12px bold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] teal-700 eyebrow 'Live preview', a 24-30px bold ink-900 'Documents by cluster' h2, and a 14px ink-500 caption ('The exact same markup. Wide screens get a table, narrow screens get cards. Try resizing.'); right = a small segmented toggle (rounded-lg ink-200 border, white, p-1) with an active teal-700 'Table' chip (white text) next to an inactive 'Cards' chip (ink-500).

### Responsive table (the centerpiece)
A semantic <table class='rt'> with a sr-only caption, a real thead (Cluster, Owner, Pending approval, Pending signature, Overdue, Status) and a tbody of rows. DESKTOP (>=920px): the table becomes a white rounded-18px panel with an ink-200 border, overflow-hidden and a soft teal-tinted drop shadow; thead shows as an ink-100 (#f1f5f9) header row of 12px uppercase tracking ink-600 labels with a bottom ink-200 border; tbody rows are real table-rows with a teal-50 (#f0fdfa) hover tint and #f1f5f9 row hairlines, ~0.95rem cells, the numeric columns (.num) right-aligned with tabular-nums; the first cell (Cluster) is bold ink-900 with extra left padding; the Status cell holds a rounded-full pill. MOBILE-FIRST (<920px): thead is display:none and each tr becomes a block card (white, ink-200 border, a 3px teal-700 left border, rounded-14px, soft shadow, ~0.85rem gap between cards); each td becomes a flex justify-between row whose label comes from content: attr(data-label) (10-11px uppercase tracking ink-500) on the left and the value on the right, with #f1f5f9 dividers; the first td (Cluster) acts as the card title (bold, larger, a teal 'Cluster' eyebrow via ::before, bottom ink-200 border). Below the table, a small centered ink-500 caption with an info icon: 'Below 920px, every row above re-renders as a labeled card. Same HTML, no JavaScript.' Sample rows: five 'Learning Complex' clusters with owners, three right-aligned tabular counts, and an On track / At risk / Overdue status pill.

### Dark prompt-library strip
Full-bleed band on ink-900 (#0f172a) with white text. Centered intro (max-w-2xl): a 12px bold uppercase tracking-[0.14em] teal-300 eyebrow 'Prompt library', a 24-30px bold white h2 'Start from a proven table prompt', and an ink-300 subhead. Then a responsive grid (sm:2-col, lg:3-col, gap-4) of three cards, each rounded-2xl with a white/10 border on a near-transparent white/[0.03] fill and a teal-400/50 hover border: a teal-300 Lucide icon (layout-list / credit-card / users), a semibold white title (Dense data grid / Billing & invoices / Team roster) and an ink-400 description line about responsive table behavior.

### Features grid
A 3-up grid (lg:grid-cols-3, gap-6) on the canvas. Each card is rounded-2xl with an ink-200 border on white, p-6: an 11x11 rounded-xl teal-50 tile holding a teal-700 Lucide icon (smartphone / accessibility / code-2), an 18px bold ink-900 title (Cards on narrow widths / Accessible by construction / Export clean code), and a 14px ink-600 body line; the accessibility card inlines teal-700 <code> chips (teal-50 bg) for thead / th.

### Teal CTA band
Full-bleed section on solid teal-700 (#0f766e) with white text, max-w-4xl centered (py-16 to py-20): a 30-36px font-black headline 'Design your first table in a sentence.', a teal-50/90 subhead (max-w-lg), and two centered CTAs: a white pill button 'Start free' (teal-800 text, arrow-right icon, hover teal-50) and a white/40-outlined ghost 'View pricing' button (white text, hover white/10 fill).

### Footer
Slim footer on canvas with an ink-200 top border, max-w-6xl, a flex row (column on mobile, row on sm): left = a 6x6 rounded-md teal-700 tile with a white table-2 icon + bold ink-800 'Tabular'; center = a 14px ink-500 line 'Built for the prompt library. Layout anchored on a real responsive-table pattern.'; right = inline text links Docs / Github / Privacy in ink-500 with teal-700 hover.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Responsive table-to-cards with ZERO JavaScript: at >=920px a real semantic <table>, below 920px thead hides and each <tr> becomes a bordered stacked card.

### Componente
Per-cell labels surfaced on mobile via CSS content: attr(data-label) so each value keeps its column name when stacked.

### Componente
Sticky backdrop-blurred translucent top navigation bar (canvas/80 + backdrop-blur-md).

### Componente
Faint teal line-grid hero background (two linear-gradients at 28px tiles) with a top teal-300 gradient hairline.

### Componente
Semantic status pills (rounded-full) with a colored leading dot: teal On track / amber At risk / rose Overdue.

### Componente
Tabular-numeric right-aligned numeric columns (.num, font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

### Componente
A 3px teal left-accent border on each mobile card and a teal-tinted soft drop shadow on the desktop table panel.

### Componente
Full-bleed dark ink-900 prompt-library strip and a saturated teal-700 CTA band breaking the white rhythm.

## Notas Especiais
The whole point is the responsive reflow done in pure CSS, no JS: keep the real semantic <table> (thead/th with scope) so screen readers retain column context, and drive the mobile card form with display rules + content: attr(data-label) on td::before. The 920px breakpoint is deliberate (a 6-column table squeezed into a tablet width reads worse than cards, so it flips to cards below 920, not at a smaller phone-only breakpoint). Teal-700 #0f766e is the only saturated brand color used structurally (logo tile, links, primary buttons, CTA band, card left-border); teal/amber/rose are reserved for status semantics. Keep tabular-nums on the numeric columns and right-align them. Sample table data is illustrative. Icons via Iconify Lucide set. Anchored on the 'Mobile First Responsive Table - Cards' pattern by herudea (https://codepen.io/herudea/pen/YxLRWR), rebuilt as an original light-teal 'Tabular' product surface.

style.description: Clean, calm light-mode SaaS aesthetic on a near-white canvas with a single deep-teal accent and an ink/slate neutral scale. Inter throughout with OpenType character variants enabled and tabular-nums on the numeric table columns. Soft layered shadows, generous rounding on cards/panels, hairline slate borders, and semantic teal/amber/rose status pills. One dark section (near-black ink) and one saturated teal CTA band break up the white for rhythm.
